ZMB.note: Digital ID cards are said to be due by end 2026; no authentication, e-signature or PKI service is described.

facts.fact: ITWeb says Zambia's Integrated National Registration Information System (INRIS) is intended to digitise civil registration and identity management together.
ITWeb says the UNDP puts biometric enrolment at roughly 1.5 million people in a population of around 20 million, about 7.5% (6.8% of the 21.9 million held).

ZMB.note: No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates or maintains the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is described.

facts.fact: ITWeb says biometric enrolment stands at roughly 1.5 million people and the Smart Zambia Institute has said digital identity cards will be issued by the end of 2026, with digital identity still in its implementation journey.
